program='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Border cells that are not background specify the three ray colors.
    markers=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]!=8 and (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)):
                markers.append((r,c,g[r][c]))
    middle=[v for r,c,v in markers if c==w-1 or r==0]
    outer=sorted([(r,c,v) for r,c,v in markers if not (c==w-1 or r==0)])
    colors=[outer[0][2],middle[0],outer[-1][2]]
    # The objects are two cells wide and seven/nine cells long.
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==8 or (r,c) in seen or (r in (0,h-1) or c in (0,w-1)):
                continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                a,b=stack.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]!=8 and (x,y) not in seen:
                        seen.add((x,y)); stack.append((x,y))
            objects.append(cells)
    for cells in objects:
        rs=[x for x,y in cells]; cs=[y for x,y in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        height,width=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        if width==2:
            offsets={7:[1,4,5],9:[1,3,5]}[height]
            # Color 2 identifies the side away from which the rays travel.
            side=0 if any(g[r][c0]==2 for r in range(r0,r1+1)) else 1
            for off,color in zip(offsets,colors):
                rr=r0+off
                columns=range(0,c0) if side==0 else range(c1+1,w)
                for cc in columns: g[rr][cc]=color
        else:
            offsets={7:[1,2,5],9:[3,5,7]}[width]
            # Horizontal objects use the reverse color order.
            down=any(g[r1][c]==2 for c in range(c0,c1+1)) or g[r1][c0+1]!=g[r0][c0+1]
            for off,color in zip(offsets,reversed(colors)):
                cc=c0+off
                rows=range(r1+1,h) if down else range(0,r0)
                for rr in rows: g[rr][cc]=color
    return g
'''
